edit.after: Your site’s address will be your label followed by your group’s name, like <label>.demo.sovereignweb.site.
edit.reason: Clarifies the structure by using an example and removing ambiguity about the implied `.demo` suffix.

issues: The 'after' claim incorrectly states that the address will be `<label>.demo.sovereignweb.site` (hardcoded group 'demo') without mentioning that the group is selected from a predefined list. This contradicts the existing documentation, which explicitly shows the address as `<label>.<group>.sovereignweb.site` with the group being user-selected.
The 'after' claim does not align with the provided group examples (e.g., `<name>.artist.sovereignweb.site`, `<name>.company.sovereignweb.site`) and the rule that the group is chosen from a list.
No invented prices, names, or promises are present in the page text.
No private or secret material is introduced in the edit.
The English is unclear in the 'after' claim, as it does not reflect the actual process described elsewhere on the page.

suggestions.what: Move the introductory section 'A site starts as one file. This is the request that made this site:' to the top of the page, above the JSON snippet, to immediately establish context for first-time visitors.
suggestions.why: This provides an instant visual anchor and sets the purpose of the page before users dive into technical details.

suggestions.what: Group the 'Fields' section and 'Groups' section into two distinct, clearly labelled subheadings with a visual separator (e.g., a horizontal rule or bold divider) to improve readability and reduce cognitive load.
suggestions.why: This helps users quickly scan and differentiate between the core input requirements and predefined options, making the form-filling process more intuitive.

suggestions.what: Add a concise, numbered step-by-step summary of the 'How a request is made today' section, placed near the bottom of the page, to reinforce the process in a digestible format for quick reference.
suggestions.why: This reduces the need for users to re-read lengthy explanations and ensures they grasp the workflow before attempting to submit a request.
